pages.text: Set an $(l)Apothecary Table$() in a village and an unemployed villager may take it up as its $(l)Physician$(): masked, robed, and worth having. A healthy physician treats a sick neighbour every half minute, for free.$(br2)Physicians buy herbs and rat tails, and sell remedies, the kit, quicklime, and in time the whole of the Doctor's Garb and Theriac.
